purpose: Bound the order of magnitude of possible requester-pays charges under the already-frozen P0E request/byte caps. This is deliberately conservative and is not an AWS invoice guarantee.
aws_requester_pays_fact: Authenticated requester-pays requests charge the requester for request and downloaded-data costs; Hyperliquid documents requester-paid transfer for its historical S3 data.

conservative_planning_rates_usd_not_clai.note: These planning rates intentionally exceed common S3 Standard examples on AWS pricing pages so the envelope does not depend on an unverified bucket region. Exact billing can differ by region/account/free-transfer eligibility/taxes.

planning_interpretation: Under the frozen technical caps, the probe is designed to remain a cents-scale source audit. A separate explicit authorization is still required even though the expected monetary exposure is small.
